name: Muslims Unite for Pittsburgh Synagogue
label: Muslim groups raised over $200,000 for Tree of Life victims
summary: Within hours of the October 27, 2018 shooting at the Tree of Life synagogue, the Muslim groups Celebrate Mercy and MPower Change launched a fundraiser on LaunchGood to help the families of the 11 people killed with funeral and other costs. It reached its $150,000 goal from about 3,600 donors in just over 48 hours and finished at $238,634. Organizers said leftover funds would go to projects fostering Muslim-Jewish dialogue.
caveat: Totals depend on the date: about $60,000 after 24 hours (NPR), $150,000 after 48 hours (CBS), $238,634 later (Snopes, Pittsburgh Magazine), and Pittsburgh Magazine also says more than $230,000. How the money was routed was disputed online; Snopes rated the claim that Muslim groups kept it as false.
